sources.snippet: The following examples are based on Unity AI Gateway and model services. If you use model serving endpoints instead of model services, replace the model service name with an endpoint name. See Databricks-hosted foundation models available in Foundation Model APIs for a list of available foundation models and their model service and endpoint names.

sources.title: Devstral Small 2 - 256k context, multimodal, open source
sources.snippet: Devstral Small 2 is Mistral AI's 24B open-weights coding agent model, released December 9, 2025 under Apache 2.0. It scores 68.0% on SWE-bench Verified and supports agentic software engineering tasks, multi-step reasoning, and tool use. Runs on a single RTX 4090 GPU or a Mac with 32GB RAM. Multimodal, with support for image inputs.
